title: Fix ClassesPanel VFS-to-doc sync data loss: edits lost on publish/test/unmount before 600ms debounce + no re-hydrate on doc change
description: Cross-feature integration audit found data-loss bugs at the ClassesPanel VFS<->doc.asClasses sync seam (packages/authoring-ui/src/ClassesPanel.tsx). The .fla persistence + Live Preview + autosave all compile/serialize from doc.asClasses, but ClassesPanel writes edits to the VFS immediately and only reconciles into doc.asClasses on a 600ms debounce — so edits are lost if anything reads the doc first. FIX ALL THREE: (1) HIGH/DATA-LOSS: a class edit then Test Movie / Publish / Live-Preview-recompile before the 600ms debounce fires compiles stale doc.asClasses and loses the edit (ClassesPanel.tsx ~179-191 handleScriptChange debounce; useExportHandlers.ts ~229 testMovie; usePublish.ts ~133-162 compileDocToBytes have no pre-flush). Make doc.asClasses reflect class edits reliably before any compile/save — preferred: update doc.asClasses synchronously/promptly on edit (keep a light debounce for history/pushDoc if needed for perf, but ensure publish/preview/save always see the latest edit), OR expose a flush and call it before compile. Simplest robust approach is to treat doc.asClasses as the source of truth and sync edits into it immediately (VFS is the editor surface). (2) MEDIUM/DATA-LOSS: on ClassesPanel UNMOUNT (closing the Classes tab) with a pending debounced sync, flush it (sync immediately) so the edit isn't dropped (ClassesPanel.tsx ~171-176 cleanup only clears the timer). (3) MEDIUM: VFS hydration effect is keyed on flaPath only (~129), so a project restore that changes doc.asClasses after mount leaves the panel showing stale classes — re-hydrate when the doc/asClasses identity changes (add to deps, guarded against clobbering an in-progress edit) or defer mount until restore. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable). Add regression tests: (a) edit a class then immediately compile/publish -> the compiled doc.asClasses includes the edit (no 600ms wait); (b) edit then unmount -> doc.asClasses has the edit; (c) doc.asClasses changing after mount re-hydrates the panel/VFS. Don't regress existing ClassesPanel tests. Update docs/33-as2-classes-vfs.md (sync semantics). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: ClassesPanel.tsx (+ maybe a tiny pre-compile flush hook) + tests.
